name: 2024-08 Public Hearing Notice - SUP24-00013 (EA-CE-2024-087) - English
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
  SUP24-00013 (EA-CE-2024-087)

  Pursuant to law, the Inglewood Planning Commission hereby gives notice that a public hearing will be held to
  determine whether or not a Special Use Permit shall be granted under Chapter 12, Articles 7 and 25, of the
  Inglewood Municipal Code. Notices of this hearing are mailed to all owners of properties located within five hundred
  feet of the subject property described below, as shown on records of the County of Los Angeles. At the following
  date and time, any and all persons may give testimony for or against the following request:

  DATE:  Wednesday, August 7, 2024
  HOUR:  7:00 p.m.

  PLACE OF HEARING:  City Council Chambers, Ninth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, One Manchester
  Boulevard, Inglewood.

  PROPERTY INVOLVED:  209 West Arbor Vitae Street (District 3)

  LEGAL DESCRIPTION:  A portion of Lots 1, 2, and 3 of Tract 298 (AIN 4022-023-020)

  REQUEST:  A Special Use Permit request to allow outdoor dining for an existing
  approximately 21,500 square-foot grocery store that is part of an existing
  multiple tenant commercial building, on an approximately 1.92 acre, C-2
  (General Commercial) zoned property.

  APPLICANT:  Steve Sohn

  ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT:  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2024-087) has been prepared stating that the
  proposed project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act, a copy of which is available for public review in the Planning
  Division office of City Hall and via email request to al-
  martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  CASE PLANNER:  Any questions regarding this case should be directed to Angel Leon-Martell,
  Assistant Planner, at (310) 412-5230.

  DATE NOTICE MAILED:  Friday, July 25, 2024
  INGLEWOOD CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  Larry Springs, Chairman

  VICINITY MAP:

The Planning Commission is requested to make a determination on the aforementioned project. In making a determination for the project, they must
also make an environmental determination.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester Boulevard,
4th Floor, Inglewood, California 90301. All requests for accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to the day of the hearing.

"If you challenge this Special Use Permit in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing
described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the Planning Commission at, or prior to, the public hearing."

In the event that this Planning Commission meeting is not held, or is concluded prior to this public hearing agenda item being considered, the public
hearing will automatically be continued to the next regularly scheduled Planning Commission meeting.

If you are no longer the owner of the noticed property, please forward this notice to the new property owner.

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita mas informacion, favor de llamar a este numero (310) 412-5230."

  See Reverse for Spanish Translation
